out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the 3 compartment sink being used to store sheet tray and other food preparation equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Person in charge removed all items from hand sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw pork stored above prepared banana leaves and cooked vegetables.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Person in charge placed all raw meat below all foods that are ready to eat.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Observed cooked ham (47-66 after 7 hours) in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. Person in charge discarded ham.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked pork (47F), cooked rice flour dumpling with pork filling (65F), cooked onion and mushroom (45F), in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Person in charge discarded listed items.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: walk in cooler at (49F)
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. Person in charge discarded eggs.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Observed prescription medications stored in shelving above prep surfaces in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Person in charge placed all medications in designated storage away from food and food preparation surfaces..

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Variance Requirement, Health Department Determines Need
violations.observation: Observed a specialized processing method of food preservation used for raw fermented pork (nem chua) prepared in the traditional style (24 hours at ambient temperature before being put under temperature control)
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall obtain a variance from the Regulatory Authority as specified in 8-103.10 and under 8-103.11 before: 1. smoking food as a method of food preservation rather than as a method for flavor enhancement, 2. curing food, 3. using food additives or adding components such as vinegar, 4. packaging food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method, 5. operating a molluscan shellfish life-support system display tank used to store and display shellfish that are offered for human consumption, 6. custom processing animals that are for personal use as food and not for sale or service in a food establishment, 7. preparing food by another method that is determined by the Regularty Authority to require a variance or, 8. sprouting seeds or beans. Person in charge will use a “fresh” style of preparation and when preparing the product, will place the item under continual refrigeration.

violations.title: Variance Requirement, Curing Food
violations.observation: The person in charge described a specialized processing method of food preservation requiring a variance from the Health Department is used for the following meat, fish, poultry, game animal, or ratite product: slow cooking of pork and beef as a means to dry out the product and make it shelf stable (jerky)
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall obtain a variance from the Regulatory Authority as specified in 8-103.10 and under 8-103.11 before: 1) smoking food as a method of food preservation rather than as a method for flavor enhancement, 2) curing food, 3) using food additives or adding components such as vinegar, 4) packaging food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method, 5) operating a molluscan shellfish life-support system display tank used to store and display shellfish that are offered for human consumption, 6) custom processing animals that are for personal use as food and not for sale or service in a food establishment, 7) preparing food by another method that is determined by the Regulatory Authority to require a variance, or 8) sprouting seeds or beans. Person in charge has agreed to purchase a commercially prepared product.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: observed in house hams and bologna wrapped tightly in banana leaves and stacked in large quantities for the active cooling process.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. Person in charge trained all staff members on the proper methods of cooling foods.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: walk in cooler (49F)
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Person in charge removed all items from cooler and contacted a repair technician during inspection.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: condenser fan of walk in cooler, doors of all equipment
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Person in charge will deep clean all surfaces before follow-up inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed that the end caps are missing from the protective light covering of fluorescent light fixtures in the kitchen at the front prep station.
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. Person in charge will replace light covering before next routine inspection.
